acceptance_criteria.criterion: Workflow triggers on push of tags matching v* only.
permissions: contents: write is declared at the job or workflow level.
Steps execute in the correct order: checkout → setup Node → extract changelog → install deps → build → zip VS Code → zip Claude Code → create release.
Both ZIP archives are created with flat layout (-j flag).
Archive filenames include the ${{ steps.changelog.outputs.version }} value.
The GitHub Release is created using softprops/action-gh-release@v2.
Release name is set to the extracted title, body to the extracted changelog body.
No secrets other than the implicit GITHUB_TOKEN are required.
The workflow does not commit any generated files back to the repository.
The .github/ directory is created (it does not currently exist in the repository).

summary: Created .github/workflows/release-personas.yml with 8 steps in correct order. Triggers on v* tags only, permissions: contents: write at workflow level, uses softprops/action-gh-release@v2. Both ZIPs use -j flag for flat layout. Archive names and release metadata reference steps.changelog outputs. No extra secrets required. YAML syntax validated with js-yaml locally.

All 11 AC verified against workflow file. Trigger is tags: ['v*'] only. permissions: contents: write is at workflow level. Step order matches spec. -j flag present on both zip commands. Version interpolated in both filenames. softprops/action-gh-release@v2 used. name/body wired to changelog outputs. No custom secrets. No git push/commit steps. .github/workflows/ directory created.

Code review passed. Workflow uses pinned major-version action refs (v4, v2) per Actions best practice. permissions block is minimal (contents: write only). No shell injection risks — all dynamic values come from verified GitHub context (github.ref_name) or from the controlled extract-changelog-entry.js step output. ZIP commands use subshell cd so working directory does not bleed across steps. No unnecessary env vars or secrets.
Workflow YAML is self-documenting via step names. No additional documentation required. All 11 AC met.
